title: useRadiusArcs posts helix half-turns whose R cannot reach the end point (chord 2.469 > 2R 2.468): R and end points are rounded separately, near-180 arcs are not split

labels.name: P1
labels.description: Unsafe or wrong output: gouge, collision, wrong G-code, crash, data loss; blocks a cut

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
## What happens

With the script option `useRadiusArcs: true` (#258), the Fanuc post writes the helix entry's half-turns as R arcs that no circle of the written radius can draw. The chord between the posted end points is longer than 2R:

```
G03 X2.501 Y-0.493 Z11. R1.235 F1200
G03 X0.032 Y-0.493 Z10. R1.234 F1200      <- from (2.501, -0.493): chord 2.469, 2R = 2.468
```

The two half-turns of one helix also get two different radii, R1.235 and R1.234.

## Reproduction (main 4b7a6b1e, `camcraft-cli mcp`)

The part is a 60 × 40 × 10 plate with a Ø25, 5 mm deep round pocket: a closed, outward-wound ASCII STL with 96-segment walls. The pocket floor face is picked; Bottom Z is `bottom_of_selection`. The document's post is the default Fanuc. Post without a `post` name, because #2190 drops script options when one is named.

```json
[["load_machine", {"builtin": "VMC 3-axis"}],
 ["import_model", {"path": "round.stl"}],
 ["set_stock", {"box": {"dx": 60, "dy": 40, "dz": 10}}],
 ["add_tool", {"catalog": "EM-0600-4FL"}],
 ["add_operation", {"kind": "pocket", "tool": "EM-0600-4FL", "name": "PW", "source": "round", "params": {"strategy": "waterline", "stepdown": 5}}],
 ["set_operation_geometry", {"operation": "PW", "picks": [{"model": "round", "id": "<pocket floor face>"}]}],
 ["edit_operation", {"name": "PW", "params": {"bottom_z": {"offset": 0, "reference": "bottom_of_selection"}, "helix_radius": 1.2344}}],
 ["generate", {"name": "PW"}], ["verify", {}],
 ["set_post_options", {"script_options": {"useRadiusArcs": true}}],
 ["post", {"output": "r.nc"}]]
```

`verify` is clean and the post succeeds. Four of the helix half-turns have chord − 2|R| = +0.001 mm: arcs whose end point the radius cannot reach.

## Neighbour case that works

The same job with the seeded `helix_radius` of 1.2 (0.4 × the 6 mm tool's radius) posts R1.2 half-turns whose chord is exactly 2.400 = 2R. Across its 32 arcs, none has a chord over 2|R| and none sweeps more than 180°. With `useRadiusArcs` off, the 1.2344 helix posts as I/J.

## Root cause (confirmed)

`emitArcWithRadius` in `assets/posts/fanuc.cps` writes `R` as the unrounded distance from the start point to the centre. It writes X/Y as the end point, each rounded separately to three decimals. It splits only an exact full circle (`< 1e-5`). An arc at or near 180°, which every helix half-turn is, keeps a chord equal to 2R before rounding. Rounding the end points and R separately can then put the chord over 2R, as above.

The same function, with the same full-circle-only split, is in `haas.cps`, `mazak.cps`, `doosan-dnm.cps`, `tormach.cps` and `grblhal.cps` (they were not run here).

## Expected

R-form output never posts an arc whose R cannot reach its end point. For example, arcs at or near 180° stay in I/J or are split, as the exact full circle already is. The written R and end points then agree after rounding.

## Suggested labels

Outside contributors can't set labels, so these are suggestions:

- `P1`: wrong posted G-code, but only with `useRadiusArcs` on (off by default).
- `effort:high`
- `area:post`
- `source:agent`
